newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners net buyers of Japan stocks via 12 firms. [CORRECTED 03:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Foreigners net buyers of Japan stocks via 12 firms. [CORRECTED 03:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects number of firms in headline and first paragraph to 12 from 20)
Orders placed by foreign investors through 12 foreign securities houses before the start of stock trading on Wednesday showed a net buying stance of 4.3 million shares, market sources said.
Foreign investors' sell orders totalled 23.8 million shares while buy orders amounted to 28.1 million.
